defects.title: Prefix-matching process arguments and unbound SQL identity can stop another PostgreSQL server
defects.expected: Bind the PID to the exact owned data-directory argument and the answering PostgreSQL instance; reject a mismatch before reporting readiness or signaling.
defects.reproduction: Run the unchanged candidate in evaluator e. Start e/data plus evaluator-owned e/data-suffix-a2 with the identical postgres executable and distinct private socket/port. Preserve e/data/postmaster.pid, replace only its first line with the suffix server PID, then invoke status, start, stop. Restore the real PID file and stop the actual e/data server. The retained script documents every command.
defects.observed: Both status and start exited0 and claimed verified PID1747 for e/data while SQL came from PID1726. stop delivered a fast shutdown to suffix PID1747 (its server log confirms received fast shutdown request and shut down), returned1, and left intended PID1726 accepting connections. Both were evaluator-owned; protected original PID80873 was untouched. Servers happened to start the same second, demonstrating that timestamp equality is not unique process identity.

defects.title: Lifecycle start follows a symlinked server log and writes outside the runtime
defects.expected: Reject a symlinked runtime log before starting PostgreSQL or writing through that path, consistent with the brief prohibition on symlink traversal and documented runtime-path guarantee.
defects.reproduction: With evaluator cluster stopped, preserve e runtime/server.log, replace it with a symlink to evaluator-owned review-evidence/symlink-target.log containing a sentinel, then run candidate start/status/stop. Restore original log after all three actions.
defects.observed: All three commands exited0. PostgreSQL startup and shutdown messages were appended through the symlink to the evaluator sentinel outside the runtime. Ancestor symlink guards pass their dedicated tests, but LOG is passed directly to pg_ctl without a symlink check. Only an evaluator-owned sentinel was modified.
